name: angel
_about: A winged person (winged.js): the whole person -- makePerson's options under `person` -- with a bird's wings from the back of the chest (winged.js featherWing: ten primaries fanned from the hand, twelve secondaries along the forearm, and the coverts over their roots row on row -- greater, median, lesser, the primary coverts and the alula -- each row shorter and laid over the one behind; the outer primaries darker at the tips). k: the span, x the rig's 1 m wing; lift: how far the arms rise (degrees). Her hair a head of curls, coiled locks off the crown and round the edge (items/hair curly).
